brief.text: The UN condemned a deadly wave of drone strikes in Sudan [1]. Europe is preparing for direct talks with Putin, with a proposal that Russia gets Donbas and Ukraine gets NATO membership, according to the FT [2]. Trump said the US is winning the war and 'can leave right now' [3].
